title_zh: 全球健康与长寿每日简报
intro_zh: 每日汇总功能医学、长寿医学、精准营养、营养补剂与健康管理五大领域的中英文权威资讯，每条附原始出处链接。
intro_en: A daily digest of authoritative Chinese and international coverage across functional medicine, longevity medicine, precision nutrition, dietary supplements and health management — every item links to its original source.

items.title_zh: 《细胞》：肠道菌把「硝酸盐＋铁」合成 DNIC，为心脏代谢撑起保护伞
items.title_en: Cell: Gut bacteria turn dietary nitrate plus iron into DNIC to protect cardiometabolic health
items.summary_zh: 瑞典卡罗林斯卡医学院在《细胞》报道：肠道细菌借硝酸盐还原酶，用饮食中的硝酸盐与非血红素铁合成二亚硝酰铁配合物（DNIC）。该分子半衰期逾 3 小时，随血抵达心、肝、肾，激活 sGC-cGMP 并抑制 mTORC1-SREBP1。西式饮食模型小鼠干预 8 周后血压、心脏结构、血管功能、血糖血脂与脂肪肝均改善；作者提醒勿自行大剂量补铁或硝酸盐。
items.summary_en: Karolinska Institutet researchers reported in Cell that gut bacteria use nitrate reductase to build dinitrosyl iron complexes (DNIC) from dietary nitrate and non-heme iron. Stable for over three hours, DNIC travels to heart, liver and kidney, activating sGC-cGMP while suppressing mTORC1-SREBP1. Eight weeks of intervention improved blood pressure, cardiac structure, vascular function, glucose, lipids and fatty liver in mice on a Western diet; the authors caution against self-dosing iron or nitrate supplements.

items.title_zh: 867 位老人数据：肠菌经「精氨酸—蝶呤—多巴胺」轴影响学习记忆
items.title_en: In 867 older adults, gut microbes shape learning and memory via an arginine–pterin–dopamine axis
items.summary_zh: 基于西班牙「老年影像组学」队列 867 位老人的符号数字模态测试与粪便宏基因组，《Gut Microbes》研究筛出 12 种与更高认知评分相关的菌种，高分组菌群富集精氨酸代谢与四氢生物蝶呤合成通路。粪菌移植后小鼠水迷宫表现提升、皮层与海马 CA1 神经元密度增加，海马精氨酸与蝶呤类升高，多巴胺受体 Drd1/Drd2/Drd5 上调。
items.summary_en: Using symbol-digit modality scores and faecal metagenomes from 867 participants in a Spanish ageing cohort, a Gut Microbes study identified 12 bacterial species linked to better cognition, with arginine metabolism and tetrahydrobiopterin synthesis enriched in high scorers. Faecal transplantation improved water-maze learning in mice, raised cortical and hippocampal CA1 neuron density, increased hippocampal arginine and pterins, and upregulated dopamine receptors Drd1, Drd2 and Drd5.

items.title_zh: 隔日禁食消退肝纤维化：一条「肝细胞—星状细胞」轴被勾勒清楚
items.title_en: Alternate-day fasting resolves liver fibrosis through a hepatocyte-to-stellate-cell axis
items.source_zh: 腾讯新闻（西安交通大学）
items.summary_zh: 西安交大冯智辉团队在《先进科学》报告：隔日禁食使肝细胞 SDHAF4 下调、线粒体复合物Ⅱ组装受阻，代偿性上调 eNOS 释放一氧化氮。NO 一方面改善肝、肌肉、脂肪的胰岛素敏感性，另一方面旁分泌至肝星状细胞，令 ATG7 第 184 位半胱氨酸发生 S-亚硝基化，阻断 ATG7-ATG5/12 结合、抑制自噬流，使星状细胞维持静息、纤维化消退。
items.summary_en: A Xi'an Jiaotong University team reported in Advanced Science that alternate-day fasting lowers hepatocyte SDHAF4, impairing mitochondrial complex II assembly and driving compensatory eNOS-derived nitric oxide. NO improves insulin sensitivity in liver, muscle and fat, and acts in parallel on hepatic stellate cells, where S-nitrosylation of ATG7 at Cys184 blocks ATG7-ATG5/12 interaction and autophagic flux, keeping stellate cells quiescent and allowing fibrosis to resolve.

items.title_zh: 运动流出的乳酸给肝脏自噬「开锁」：WDR41 乳酰化是关键一步
items.title_en: Exercise-derived lactate unlocks hepatic autophagy via WDR41 lactylation
items.summary_zh: 中国农大刘蓉、任发政团队在《自噬》发表研究：WDR41 是一种促自噬蛋白，其表达与乳酰化水平同多种人类肝脏代谢疾病呈负相关；运动等自噬诱导条件下 WDR41 发生乳酰化，从而启动自噬。该结果把「运动—乳酸—蛋白乳酰化—肝脏自噬」连成一条可验证的通路，为代谢性肝病的生活方式干预提供了分子层面的解释。
items.summary_en: A China Agricultural University team reported in Autophagy that WDR41 is a pro-autophagic protein whose expression and lactylation correlate inversely with several human liver metabolic diseases. Under autophagy-inducing conditions such as exercise, WDR41 becomes lactylated and switches on autophagy, linking exercise, lactate, protein lactylation and hepatic autophagy into one testable pathway that helps explain lifestyle benefits in metabolic liver disease.

items.title_zh: 《免疫》：颗粒酶 K 驱动器官纤维化，却与免疫衰老「解耦」
items.title_en: Immunity: Granzyme K drives organ fibrosis yet is decoupled from immune ageing
items.summary_zh: 莫纳什大学团队在《免疫》发表研究：衰老记忆性 CD8⁺ T 细胞上调的颗粒酶 K（GzmK）是年龄相关组织衰退的驱动因素。敲除 GzmK 的老年小鼠免疫衰老表型依旧存在，但器官衰老显著减轻——肾脏补体沉积减少，肝脏纤维化改善并伴核心蛋白聚糖升高、TGF-β 信号减弱。研究据此把机体衰老与免疫衰老分开，将 GzmK 列为不损免疫功能的抗衰靶点。
items.summary_en: A Monash University team reported in Immunity that granzyme K (GzmK), upregulated in aged memory CD8+ T cells, drives age-related tissue decline. GzmK-knockout mice retained immune-ageing phenotypes yet showed markedly less organ ageing: less renal complement deposition and improved liver function with higher decorin and weaker TGF-beta signalling. The work separates organismal from immune ageing and nominates GzmK as a target for healthier ageing without compromising immunity.

items.title_zh: 东方抗衰老大会落地上海静安：抗衰老研究院设上海分院，四个专委会揭牌
items.title_en: East Anti-Ageing Congress opens in Shanghai: research institute branch and four committees launched
items.summary_zh: 11 月 15 日，上海市数理医学学会与沈阳药科大学抗衰老研究院联合主办的东方抗衰老大会在静安举行。会上启动 AI 赋能全病程管理计划（TrustMedix），发布医疗健康数据授权运营与质量管理两项团体标准；沈阳药科大学抗衰老研究院上海分院成立，「老年功能维护和健康长寿」等四个专委会揭牌。上海已把提高健康预期寿命纳入卫生健康「十五五」规划指标。
items.summary_en: On 15 November the East Anti-Ageing Congress, co-hosted by the Shanghai Society of Mathematical Medicine and Shenyang Pharmaceutical University's anti-ageing institute, opened in Jing'an. It launched an AI-enabled full-course management plan (TrustMedix), released two group standards on health-data authorisation and quality, opened a Shanghai branch of the anti-ageing institute and inaugurated four committees including one on functional maintenance and healthy longevity. Shanghai has added healthy life expectancy to its 15th five-year health plan targets.

items.title_zh: 2026 全球长寿产业报告：核心市场 316–346 亿美元，商业模式转向会员制
items.title_en: 2026 Global Longevity Industry Report: core market at US$31.6–34.6bn as business models shift to membership
items.source_zh: 网易（全球医生组织北京代表处）
items.summary_zh: 《2026 年全球长寿产业报告》梳理产业规模与商业模式：2026 年全球核心长寿市场约 316–346 亿美元，预防长寿医学技术与服务市场约 4126–4159 亿美元，两者统计口径交叉不可相加。成熟商业化集中在心血管代谢健康、疾病风险早筛与功能维护；机构收入正从单次评估转向会员制与长期健康管理，客户留存与临床可信度被列为核心竞争力。
items.summary_en: The 2026 Global Longevity Industry Report maps market size and business models: the global core longevity market is estimated at US$31.6–34.6 billion in 2026, with preventive longevity technology and services at US$412.6–415.9 billion, overlapping categories that cannot simply be added. Commercial maturity clusters in cardiometabolic health, early risk detection and functional maintenance, while revenue is shifting from one-off assessments to membership and long-term management, with retention and clinical credibility named as core advantages.

items.title_zh: 「融合老年科学」综述：把社会、人口与生物学衰老放进同一张图
items.title_en: Review argues for integrating social, demographic and biological ageing research
items.summary_zh: 一篇综述提出「融合老年科学」框架：雷帕霉素、达沙替尼联合槲皮素、OSKM 部分重编程等机制指导的干预已在动物中验证，但向人群转化受剂量、组织特异性、衰老细胞负荷与致瘤风险制约。作者主张把人类异质性、暴露史、共病与群体情境纳入研究设计，回答「这些干预对谁有效、如何有效」，而非继续在均质模型中追求单一通路效应。
items.summary_en: A review proposes an integrated geroscience framework: mechanism-guided interventions such as rapamycin, dasatinib plus quercetin and OSKM partial reprogramming work in animals but translation is limited by dosing, tissue specificity, senescent-cell burden and tumorigenic risk. The authors argue for embedding human heterogeneity, exposure history, comorbidity and population context into study design so research can answer who responds and how, rather than chasing single-pathway effects in homogeneous models.

items.title_zh: 膳食纤维护肠并非人人有效：297 人研究指向 FUT2 基因
items.title_en: Fibre benefits for gut health vary by FUT2 genotype in a 297-person study
items.summary_zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校等团队在《营养学杂志》发表横断面研究：297 名健康成人中，近期与习惯性总纤维、可溶性纤维摄入越高，粪便钙卫蛋白越低，但这一关联仅见于 FUT2「分泌型」人群；非分泌型人群未见关联，两组菌群整体组成也无差异。作者强调这是关联而非因果，且明确反对据此做基因检测定制食谱，需随机对照试验验证。
items.summary_en: A cross-sectional study in The Journal of Nutrition of 297 healthy adults found that higher recent and habitual total and soluble fibre intake tracked with lower faecal calprotectin only among FUT2 secretors; no association appeared in non-secretors, and overall microbiome composition did not differ between groups. The authors stress the findings are associative, call for randomised trials, and explicitly advise against using FUT2 testing to personalise diets.

items.title_zh: 绿色地中海饮食 18 个月：胰腺内脂肪降 14%，血糖改善独立于减重
items.title_en: Green-Mediterranean diet cuts pancreatic fat by 14% over 18 months, independent of weight loss
items.summary_zh: 一项纳入约三百人、随访 18 个月的国际研究用高精度腹部磁共振追踪胰腺脂肪：绿色地中海饮食组胰腺脂肪下降 14%，常规膳食指导组仅降 0.8%。多酚摄入越多，脂肪清除越明显；面包、精制谷物等精制碳水则阻碍这一过程。校正体重与腹腔脂肪下降后，胰腺脂肪清除仍与胰岛素抵抗、血糖指标改善独立相关，且保留功能性胰腺体积。
items.summary_en: An international study of about 300 participants followed for 18 months used high-resolution abdominal MRI to track pancreatic fat: the green-Mediterranean group dropped 14% versus 0.8% with standard dietary advice. Higher polyphenol intake predicted greater clearance, while refined carbohydrates such as bread and refined grains hindered it. After adjusting for weight and visceral fat loss, pancreatic fat clearance remained independently associated with better insulin resistance and glucose markers, with functional pancreatic volume preserved.

items.title_zh: 特医食品「十岁」：1.1 亿住院人次中四成有营养风险，14 省市可刷医保个人账户
items.title_en: China's formula food sector at ten: 40% of 110 million annual admissions at nutrition risk
items.summary_zh: 第一财经回顾特医食品十年：我国每年 1.1 亿人次住院，约 40% 存在营养不良风险，但营养筛查与干预尚未成为普遍诊疗流程。行业堵点还包括固体饮料冒充特医婴配、注册投入回报倒挂、跨境与国产规则不对称。破局方向有三：把营养筛查写进诊疗流程、以「AI＋精准营养＋智能制造」做柔性定制、以本土循证支撑支付；目前 14 个省市已将特医食品纳入医保个人账户支付。
items.summary_en: Yicai reviewed a decade of China's foods for special medical purposes: of 110 million hospital admissions a year, about 40% carry malnutrition risk, yet nutrition screening and intervention are not routine. Other bottlenecks include solid beverages sold as infant formula, poor returns on registration investment, and asymmetric rules between cross-border and domestic products. Proposed fixes are embedding screening in care pathways, AI plus precision nutrition and flexible manufacturing, and domestic evidence to support reimbursement; 14 provinces now allow payment from personal medical-savings accounts.

items.title_zh: 「先证据、再应用」：珍奥把核苷酸营养推向「检测—分层—复盘」
items.title_en: "Evidence first, then application": Zhen'ao moves nucleotide nutrition toward test, stratify, review
items.summary_zh: 珍奥三十周年之际，徐斌表示将继续「科研走在营销前面」，围绕核苷酸营养做基础研究，并把合规要求贯穿研发与成果转化。企业已建符合 ISO15189 的基因检测示范中心，试图以基因检测与指标动态跟踪替代「千人一方」的统一剂量与周期，形成有检测、有分层、有复盘的营养干预路径。
items.summary_en: At its 30th anniversary, Zhen'ao's Xu Bin said the firm will keep "research ahead of marketing" on nucleotide nutrition, embedding compliance across R&D and translation. It has built an ISO 15189-aligned genetic testing demo centre, aiming to replace one-size-fits-all dosing and cycles with testing, risk stratification and periodic review of individual biomarkers.

items.title_zh: 鱼油新争议：EPA 经 LRP5 进入 NK 细胞，反而削弱抗癌力
items.title_en: Fish oil controversy: EPA enters NK cells via LRP5 and blunts tumour killing
items.summary_zh: 《科学·信号》刊出研究：多不饱和脂肪酸经 LRP5 转运进入自然杀伤细胞后，降低 mTORC1 活性与葡萄糖利用，并减少颗粒酶 B 表达，使 NK 细胞杀伤肿瘤能力下降；小鼠结肠癌与黑色素瘤模型中，阻断该转运或减少必需脂肪酸供给可增强抗癌力、减缓肿瘤生长。作者提示这是机制研究，不能据此推断人群补鱼油会促癌，但「越多越好」的说法缺乏依据。
items.summary_en: A Science Signaling study found that polyunsaturated fatty acids enter natural killer cells through LRP5, lowering mTORC1 activity and glucose use and reducing granzyme B, which weakens tumour killing. In mouse colon cancer and melanoma models, blocking this transport or restricting essential fatty acids strengthened NK activity and slowed tumour growth. The authors stress this is mechanistic work and does not show that fish oil supplements promote cancer in people, though claims that more is better lack support.

items.title_zh: 保健食品「出海一日游」：伪造三单、空壳海外品牌回流被点名
items.title_en: Officials flag fake overseas supplements round-tripped through Hong Kong shell firms
items.summary_zh: 在 2026 特殊食品大会国际合作会议上，中国国际电子商务中心专家李鸣涛列出跨境电商五类突出问题：伪造订单、支付单、物流单「三单」，保健食品「出海一日游」，线下自提边界模糊，境外非处方药制度性矛盾，非正面清单商品违规入境。典型手法是国内代工产品出口至香港空壳企业、伪造海外生产资质与质检报告，再以「个人自用」豁免入境，单款月销可过万件。
items.summary_en: At the 2026 Special Food Conference, e-commerce expert Li Mingtao listed five cross-border problems: forged order, payment and logistics documents; health foods exported and re-imported in a single trip; blurred boundaries for offline pickup; structural conflicts over overseas over-the-counter drugs; and goods outside the positive list entering illegally. A typical scheme ships domestic contract-manufactured products to Hong Kong shell companies, fabricates overseas production and testing credentials, then re-imports under personal-use exemptions, with single products selling over 10,000 units a month.

items.title_zh: 召回风波之后：斯维诗「跨境＋蓝帽」双轨模式面临信任考题
items.title_en: After a recall, Swisse's dual cross-border and blue-hat model faces a trust test
items.summary_zh: 斯维诗近期在澳洲生产环节发生召回，其「跨境线按原产国法规、国产线按蓝帽注册备案」的双轨模式受到追问。企业称全链路质控并定期送第三方检测，同款产品因产地不同在规格与价格上有差异。报道援引健合集团数据：前三季度成人营养业务营收 61.7 亿元、同比增 16.4%，斯维诗中国市场增 21.5%，抖音增 52.2%，但行业「大市场、小企业」与跨境依赖仍是隐忧。
items.summary_en: A recall at an Australian manufacturing site has raised questions about Swisse's dual model, in which cross-border lines follow origin-country rules and domestic lines follow Chinese registration. The company cites end-to-end quality control and periodic third-party testing, and notes that the same product can differ in specification and price by origin. The report cites H&H Group figures: adult nutrition revenue of 6.17 billion yuan in the first nine months, up 16.4%, with Swisse China up 21.5% and Douyin up 52.2%, while a fragmented market and cross-border dependence remain concerns.

items.title_zh: 长寿类声称的监管边界：连「提升 NAD」在澳洲都被拒
items.title_en: Where longevity claims stop: even "raises NAD" was refused in Australia
items.summary_zh: 在伦敦 Nutra Healthspan 峰会上，澳洲 Mills Oakley 律所 Nicoletti 指出，尽管有临床证据，澳洲仍不允许 NMN 产品宣称「提升体内 NAD」；雀巢、Niagen 等合规负责人同场。专家建议把诉求翻译成已授权表述，如「支持健康老化」「改善细胞能量」，英欧有 250 余项可对应声称；印尼 BPOM 甚至拒认 EFSA 认知声称，「延长寿命」几乎无望获批。
items.summary_en: At London's Nutra Healthspan Summit, Mills Oakley's Teresa Nicoletti said Australia still refuses an NMN claim that it "raises NAD levels" despite clinical evidence. Panellists advised translating marketing into authorised wording such as "supports healthy aging" or "cellular energy" — the UK and EU offer 250-plus claims — while "extend lifespan" is unlikely to clear regulators.

items.title_zh: 湖北「一张处方」扩容：第二批 34 个县启动，电子处方流转约 65 万份
items.title_en: Hubei widens "one prescription" reform to 34 more counties, 650,000 e-prescriptions circulated
items.summary_zh: 湖北省卫健委等印发通知，第二批 34 个县（市、区）启动「一张处方」改革。首批 23 个试点地区 27 个医共体全部建成县域中心药房，村卫生室药品种类不少于 80 种；电子处方中心累计流转约 65 万份，群众可就近取药并实时报销。赤壁市慢病建档率、规范管理率分别达 95%、90.5%。
items.summary_en: Hubei's health commission launched the second wave of its "one prescription" reform across 34 counties. All 27 medical communities in the first 23 pilot areas now run county-level central pharmacies, with village clinics stocking at least 80 medicines; about 650,000 e-prescriptions have circulated, letting residents fill and reimburse nearby. Chibi reports 95% chronic-disease filing and 90.5% managed rates.

items.title_zh: 上海建档糖尿病高危人群 257.4 万，231 家社区建成慢病支持中心
items.title_en: Shanghai registers 2.57 million people at high diabetes risk, with 231 community support centres
items.summary_zh: 第 20 个联合国糖尿病日，上海公布慢病防控数据：截至 2026 年，全市建档在册血糖风险人群累计 257.4 万人，已接受糖尿病筛查者 114.1 万人；年内新登记糖尿病患者 10.8 万人，社区随访在管患者 101.2 万人。全市 231 家社区卫生服务中心设立慢病健康管理支持中心，可开展综合风险评估、筛查、智能随访与标准化血压血糖测量。
items.summary_en: Marking the 20th UN Diabetes Day, Shanghai released chronic disease figures: by 2026 the city had registered 2.574 million people at high blood-glucose risk, with 1.141 million screened; 108,000 new diabetes cases were recorded during the year and 1.012 million patients were under community follow-up. A total of 231 community health centres now host chronic disease management support centres offering risk assessment, screening, smart follow-up and standardised blood pressure and glucose measurement.

items.title_zh: 国家卫健委提示理性减重：95% 以上三级公立综合医院已设体重管理门诊
items.title_en: NHC urges sensible weight loss as over 95% of tertiary hospitals open weight clinics
items.source_zh: 武汉市体育局（转《中国体育报》）
items.summary_zh: 针对部分减肥训练营以「急速暴瘦」「不瘦退款」招揽学员、靠过度节食与超负荷训练减重并多次发生伤亡，国家卫健委提示：体重不是越轻越好，过度节食与超负荷运动可致脱水、脱发、电解质紊乱与肌肉流失；减重前应做医学与运动风险评估，出现胸闷心悸头晕须立即停止；目前超过 95% 的三级公立综合医院已设置健康体重管理门诊。
items.summary_en: Responding to weight-loss camps advertising rapid results and money-back promises built on extreme dieting and overtraining, some ending in deaths, the National Health Commission warns that lighter is not healthier: crash dieting and excessive exercise can cause dehydration, hair loss, electrolyte imbalance and muscle loss. It advises medical and exercise risk assessment before any programme, immediate stopping if chest tightness, palpitations or dizziness occur, and notes that over 95% of tertiary public general hospitals now run healthy weight management clinics.

items.title_zh: 个人医保云落地慢病管理：4.5 亿患者有了「出院后盯护」
items.title_en: Personal medical-insurance cloud brings post-discharge AI monitoring to 450 million patients
items.summary_zh: 湖南湘江新区企业基于国家级「医保云」推出慢病全周期方案：整合医保结算、院内报告、用药明细与家用血压计、血糖仪数据，生成动态健康画像；居家监测异常自动触发复诊预警，家庭医生收到随访任务。方案依托覆盖 3.5 万余个病种、3550 万医学实体的知识图谱与多模态大模型，其肾慢病路径获 2026 全国智慧医保大赛一等奖。我国慢病患者约 4.5 亿，慢病死亡占居民总死亡 88%。
items.summary_en: A Hunan Xiangjiang New Area company has built a full-cycle chronic disease programme on China's national personal medical-insurance cloud, merging claims records, hospital reports, medication details and home blood pressure and glucose readings into a live health profile. Abnormal home readings trigger revisit alerts while family doctors receive follow-up tasks. The system relies on a knowledge graph covering more than 35,000 diseases and 35.5 million medical entities plus a multimodal model; its kidney-disease pathway won first prize at the 2026 national smart insurance competition. China has about 450 million chronic disease patients, and such diseases account for 88% of deaths.
